name: Last Island of Survival
summary: Last Island of Survival is your last fortress of surviving this wasted open world. Make your own rules of survival in this multiplayer zombie survival game full of action and adventures! Start an exciting journey and lifeafter on this post-apocalyptic island and survive hunger, dehydration, dangerous wildlife and other malicious survivors. Scavenge resources, craft weapons, and build shelter to survive. Will you be the last of us standing?
